title: Meshless Latent Dynamics Models for Model Order Reduction of time-dependent Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.41043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent dynamics learning has emerged as a prominent approach for Model Order Reduction (MOR) of time-dependent, parameterized Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). Traditional autoencoder-based approaches are intrinsically tied to fixed spatial discretizations during both training and inference, motivating the development of meshless methodologies. In this context, conditioning provides a natural mechanism for representing temporal evolution through spatially continuous functions, enabling mesh-agnostic Latent Dynamics Models (LDMs).   In this work, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for mesh-agnostic LDMs based on conditioning in Neural Fields (NeFs). Leveraging a taxonomy of conditioning mechanisms (weak, strong, and pure), we formulate meshless LDMs as NeFs conditioned on a latent state. We establish a Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) for this class of models and analyze their stability by deriving Lipschitz bounds

translated_title: 用于时变偏微分方程模型降阶的无网格潜动力学模型
translated_abstract: 潜动力学学习已成为时变参数化偏微分方程（PDE）模型降阶（MOR）的一种重要方法。传统的基于自编码器的方法在训练和推理过程中本质上依赖于固定的空间离散化，这促使了无网格方法的发展。在此背景下，条件化提供了一种通过空间连续函数表示时间演化的自然机制，使得与网格无关的潜动力学模型（LDM）成为可能。在本工作中，我们引入了一个统一的数学框架，用于基于神经场中条件化的与网格无关的潜动力学模型。利用条件化机制的分类法（弱条件化、强条件化和纯条件化），我们将无网格潜动力学模型表述为以潜状态为条件的神经场。我们为这类模型建立了万能逼近定理（UAT），并通过推导Lipschitz界分析了它们的稳定性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于神经场条件化机制的统一数学框架，将无网格潜动力学模型表述为以潜状态为条件的神经场，并建立了万能逼近定理和基于Lipschitz界的稳定性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified mathematical framework for mesh-agnostic latent dynamics models formulated as neural fields conditioned on latent states, establishing a Universal Approximation Theorem and stability analysis via Lipschitz bounds.
